name: ID
description: A unique identifier for each soil or cacao leaf sample.

name: Lon
description: The geographic longitude coordinate of the sample location.

name: Lat
description: The geographic latitude coordinate of the sample location.

name: region
description: The specific geographical region in Côte d'Ivoire where the sample was collected.

name: Produc
description: The yield of dry cacao beans measured in kilograms per hectare.

name: N
description: The total nitrogen content in the sample, expressed as a percentage.

name: P
description: The total phosphorus content in the sample, expressed as a percentage.

name: K
description: The total potassium content in the sample, expressed as a percentage.

name: Ca
description: The total calcium content in the sample, expressed as a percentage.

name: Mg
description: The total magnesium content in the sample, expressed as a percentage.

name: Fe
description: The iron concentration in the sample, measured in parts per million (ppm).

name: Mn
description: The manganese concentration in the sample, measured in parts per million (ppm).

name: B
description: The boron concentration in the sample, measured in parts per million (ppm).

name: Cu
description: The copper concentration in the sample, measured in parts per million (ppm).

name: Mo
description: The molybdenum concentration in the sample, measured in parts per million (ppm).

name: Zn
description: The zinc concentration in the sample, measured in parts per million (ppm).
